verdict.rationale: A tax agency could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The pack shows EFILE, a system-to-system channel for certified software, but nothing about API versioning, version lifecycles, or a published deprecation policy. ReFILE's list of supported tax years describes which returns can be filed, not API versions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
